text:
Priya K: Hey team — customer tenant 98765 says their app started getting 429s ~10m ago on /v1/generate. They're seeing ~3–5s latency spikes before the 429s. Dashboard doesn't show obvious burst pattern. Can someone help triage?

ops-bot: alert: tenant=98765 route=/v1/generate count=3200 window=10m severity=high :rotating_light:

Marcos G: Thanks — can you paste a sample request id and timestamp? I want to correlate API logs + token metrics. Also which model were they hitting?

Priya K: sample request id: req_20260301_89ab, sample time: 2026-03-01T15:02:12Z. Customer says model param was "orca-14b-quant" and they were doing short completions (~100 tokens) but in tight loop.

Evan L: On it. Quick checks: 1) per-tenant token rate over 1m/5m, 2) per-route concurrent inflight, 3) model capacity usage on Dedicated pool. If they're in Hosted, we need to see if auto-burst caps hit.

Marcos G: Running a quick PromQL to attribute by route+tenant: 
```
sum(rate(api_responses_total{status="429", route="/v1/generate"} [1m])) by (tenant_id, model_name)
```
That should show which model/tenant pair is producing most 429s.

Evan L: Also look at prefix cache hit rate. Low cache + high qps leads to higher GPU time per token. Query (example):
```
sum(rate(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (tenant_id, route) / sum(rate(api_requests_total[5m])) by (tenant_id, route)
```
If miss rate > 0.6 and qps > 150, that's trouble for small models.

Priya K: I ran the first query — it shows tenant 98765 + orca-14b-quant = 2.9 rps of 429s in last 1m, and another tenant 34211 spiking too. Link: https://kibana.redwood/investigations/98765 (private)

Marcos G: Ok that confirms multi-tenant burst. Policy check: their plan has burst window 60s with bucket size 1000 tokens. If they loop rapidly, they can exhaust the token bucket even if per-minute looks fine. We should show token-bucket fullness in dashboard.

Priya K: Customer repro steps below — they run a 5-thread client hitting /v1/generate with 50ms between calls.
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"orca-14b-quant","input":"summary"}'
2) repeat in tight loop for 2m
They say 1.5m in that run before 429s appear.

Evan L: Thanks. For immediate mitigation: 1) increase their burst bucket temporarily (if enterprise) or 2) enable per-route soft-throttling to smooth spikes. I'll also add a 1-min rolling alert for token-exhaust per tenant. Suggested alert (pseudo):
````
WHEN sum(rate(token_consumed_total[1m])) by (tenant_id) > (tenant_burst_capacity / 60 * 0.9)
FOR 2m
THEN page oncall
````

Marcos G: Long-term: update the limits dashboard to include: 1) rolling token consumption per tenant (1m/5m), 2) 429s by route+model, 3) cache miss heatmap, 4) avg GPU utilization per model. That will speed future attributions. I'll create a dashboard panel and a saved PromQL for product.

Priya K: Can we also add an ownership annotation for routes so Support can see contact (SRE vs Platform)? Customer asked for ETA on fix.

Marcos G: I'll own dashboard + alert config. ETA ~90m to deploy panels and add saved queries. For immediate customer response: advise them to add jitter/backoff and reduce concurrency to 2 threads — should avoid 429s while we patch.

Priya K: Sending that to customer now. Thanks. :thumbsup:

console-alerts: note: auto-scaling event at 2026-03-01T15:04:50Z — scale up initiated for pool-dedicated-us-west-2, +2 GPUs

Evan L: Scaling started but burst hit happened faster. I'll follow up after dashboard is up with exact token bucket traces and recommended limits.

Priya K: Filing internal ticket and will update support case. Ticket: #SUP-5123 (pausing until dashboard panels merged).

Marcos G: Filed dashboard PR: https://git.internal/redwood/dashboards/pulls/453 — adding the token-bucket panel + 429 attribution.

Priya K: closing loop: customer reduced concurrency and 429s stopped. They'll wait on us for permanent dashboard/alert. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
